campaign: LoCoMo observation-enrichment three-way (write-time abstraction A/B + displacement control)
findings: DISPLACEMENT, not bridging: with turn-only gold, adding the 2,541 observation docs COLLAPSES turn delivery .4348 -> .2645 (multihop 120 -> 52) — the abstractions out-compete raw dialogue for seats because they are written in the question register

counting abstractions as answer-carrying gold (they are LLM-derived factual statements of exactly what the questions ask), net delivered rises .4348 -> .5189 (+8.4pp; every QA class gains, multihop +12.8pp, temporal +13.1pp)
cognitive unchanged (3 -> 2 of 401): no observation layer exists for the synthetic cues — enriching THOSE requires generating abstractions (the LLM-ribosome ingest lane)

design consequence for the enrichment lane: naive co-ingestion of abstractions cannibalizes source evidence; production needs abstraction->source linkage (support_span / provenance / delivery-time source-set dedup) so a delivered abstraction carries or pulls its source
caveats: obs arm's gold-set is larger by construction (union basis) — the ctl arm exists precisely to separate the mechanical-gold effect from ranking movement; report all three cells together
beds differ in corpus (2,541 added docs), so this is a bed+gold A/B, not a same-bed ablation; needle set identical (2,378), resolver 2378/2378 on both beds
ran alongside the muloc c=6 bed build — latency axes environment-loaded; rank/delivered axes deterministic
